title: SkillsView

ownDirectory.description: The own directory's absolute path on the environment's machine, holding skills/ and commands/, for a terminal pane or an editor to open.

id.description: A skill source's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adds the source, kept in lowercase.

url.description: A skill source's URL, as entered: https://, ssh:// or scp's [user@]host:path, naming a repository with an identity; no credential, query, fragment or leading hyphen, and no other scheme or local path. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-url and its reason; this pattern holds part of the rule, and cases/skill-source-url.json holds all of it.

identity.description: The URL's repository identity, which the source is known by with its folder.

folder.description: A folder of a repository, from its root: . for the root, else a relative path with no .. segment, kept with / between segments and no empty or . segment (a \ is read as /). Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-folder and its reason.

anyOf.description: A branch a skill source follows, as git takes a branch name: 1 to 255 characters with no white space, control character or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \, no .. or @{, no empty segment, none beginning with . or ending with .lock, no trailing / or ., not @, and not beginning with -.

branch.description: The branch; null for the remote's default branch, the one its HEAD names.

oneOf.description: A branch the source syncs from, at start, every six hours and on Pull now.

commit.description: A git commit's full object name: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

oneOf.description: A commit the source is pinned to: it never syncs until it is unpinned.

follow.description: What a skill source follows: a branch (null for the remote's default), or a pinned commit, which never syncs.

position.description: Where the source stands among the environment's sources, in the order they were added, from 1: of two sources holding one name, the earlier wins.

kind.description: What caused the event: a client session, a routine, a provider adapter or the environment itself.

id.description: The actor's id within its kind; a system component names itself.

addedBy.description: Who added the source: the client session a person added it from, or the environment's own importer.

commit.description: The commit of its current snapshot, whose members are the ones in the set.

skillCount.description: How many valid members its current snapshot yields.

since.description: When the outcome began: the time of the skills.source-synced that recorded it, the source's add for its first.

oneOf.description: ok: the current snapshot is the commit the last sync fetched.

since.description: When the outcome began: the time of the skills.source-synced that recorded it, the source's add for its first.

problem.description: Why skills.probe could not reach the repository: authentication (the forge refused the credential, or asked for one no forge account gives), not_found (no such repository or branch), network (the host could not be reached in time), git_missing (git is not installed on the environment's computer; data.line holds the spawn's ENOENT), git_failed (git failed otherwise; data.line holds its fatal: line).

line.description: What git said when the outcome began, its fatal: line where it wrote one, scrubbed of every secret.

oneOf.description: failed: the fetch could not reach the repository, for the probe's problem; the last good snapshot stays current.

since.description: When the outcome began: the time of the skills.source-synced that recorded it, the source's add for its first.

commit.description: The commit fetched, at which the folder yields no valid member.

items.description: A folder of a repository, from its root: . for the root, else a relative path with no .. segment, kept with / between segments and no empty or . segment (a \ is read as /). Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-folder and its reason.

folders.description: The folders at that commit a source would read skills from, as the probe finds them; empty for none.

oneOf.description: layout_moved: the folder yields no valid member at the commit fetched, with the folders that would; the last good snapshot stays current.

sync.description: What a source's last sync came to and since when: ok; failed, with the probe's problem and what git said; or layout_moved, with the commit fetched and the folders that would yield skills. Failed and layout_moved keep the last good snapshot current.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

attemptedAt.description: When a fetch of the source (its add, a sync or a pin at a commit) last ended, whatever it came to; null when none has since the environment started. Kept outside the log: an unchanged sync moves it and appends nothing.

items.description: A skill source as skills.get lists it: its URL, identity, folder, what it follows, its position and who added it when, the commit of its current snapshot and how many skills that snapshot yields, what its last sync came to, and when a fetch of it last ended.

sources.description: The skill sources the environment tracks, earliest added first, each with its current snapshot's commit and skill count.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accountId.description: The account the choice is for; null for the whole environment, whose choice outranks an account's.

enabled.description: Whether the name is on: off leaves it out of the set whichever layers hold it.

oneOf.description: A name switched off, or on again, for one account or the whole environment.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

accountId.description: The account whose runs append the member.

on.description: Whether every run of the account appends the member's body.

oneOf.description: A name made always-on, or not, for one account.

items.description: A choice made about a skill's name: enabled (on or off for an account, or for the whole environment with a null account, whose choice outranks an account's), or always-on for an account. Keyed by name; a choice for a name not in the set is inert.

choices.description: Every choice made on the environment, an inert one among them: by name, then enabled before always-on, then the whole environment's before the accounts', by id.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accountId.description: The account the set is resolved for: the session's, else the environment's default account; null when the environment holds none.
An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

channel.description: Its adapter's instruction channel, which an always-on skill rides: none hands its runs no always-on skill.

reason.description: Why no always-on skill reaches its runs, for a client to show beside the dimmed switch; null while its adapter has an instruction channel.

items.description: An account of the environment, with its adapter's instruction channel and, without one, why no always-on skill reaches its runs.

accounts.description: The environment's accounts, in the account list's order, each with whether an always-on skill reaches its runs.

anyOf.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

name.description: The member's name by the member-naming rule; null when none passes, a name problem saying why.

kind.description: What a member is: skill, a folder holding SKILL.md; or command, a Markdown file in the own directory's commands/, named by its file.

path.description: Where the member lies, from its layer's folder: in the own directory, skills/<folder> or commands/<file>; in a source's snapshot, its folder from the source's folder (. when that folder is itself the skill); in a trusted repository, its folder under the root.

description.description: The member's description, trimmed; null when it has none, a description problem saying so.

invocation.description: How a member is invoked: model+slash (the model may choose it, and a person may type /name), or slash-only (its frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation: true, so only /name invokes it).

userInvocable.description: Whether a person may invoke it: false exactly when its frontmatter sets user-invocable: false, which leaves it out of the / menu.

argumentHint.description: What follows the member's name in a / menu, from its frontmatter's argument-hint: text trimmed, a number as its text, or a flow list of scalars written back in brackets; null when it declares none.

items.description: A frontmatter key that acts while the skill is active, which a client says of the member: hooks (commands run on the provider's events) or allowed-tools (tools that may run without a prompt; the tool gate and the denylist still run first).

whileActive.description: The keys its frontmatter declares that act while it is active, hooks before allowed-tools; empty for none.

repository.description: The identity of the repository the member was read from: its source's, or the trusted repository's.

path.description: The member's folder in that repository, from its root; . when the root is itself the skill.

oneOf.description: The repository the member was read from, by its identity, and the member's folder there.

repository.description: The identity of the repository the manifest says the member was copied from.

path.description: The member's folder in that repository, as the manifest names it.

anyOf.description: The commit the member was copied at, as the manifest names it: its object name, full or abbreviated.

licence.description: The licence the manifest names, an SPDX identifier where it gives one; null when it names none.

oneOf.description: What a provenance manifest beside the member names: the repository and folder it was copied from, the commit and the licence.

anyOf.description: Where a member comes from, which the readiness overlay is keyed by (repository identity and folder path): the repository it was read from, or what a provenance manifest beside a copy names.

origin.description: Where it comes from; null for a member of the own directory with no provenance manifest, or of a repository with no identity.

sourceId.description: A skill source's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adds the source, kept in lowercase.

oneOf.description: The environment's own skills directory, or its commands directory.

root.description: The repository root the member lies under: .claude/skills before .agents/skills, then .claude/commands.

directory.description: The directory holding that root, from the repository's root: the workspace directory or one of its parents, . for the repository's root; a nearer one wins a name.

layer.description: The layer a member lies in: a source, the own directory, or a trusted repository's .claude/skills or .agents/skills.

size.description: Its body's length in characters, after its frontmatter, which always-on appends to every run.

tokens.description: The tokens its body approximately costs: a quarter of its size, rounded up.

kind.description: What is wrong: frontmatter (its frontmatter does not read as a YAML mapping, so nothing in it is taken), name (neither its frontmatter name nor its folder's or file's name passes the skill-name rule) or description (its frontmatter has no description, which the Agent Skills spec requires).

message.description: What is wrong, for people: the names tried and why each fails.

items.description: A problem that leaves a member invalid: it is listed with the problem and left out of the skill set.

problems.description: Empty for a valid member; any problem leaves it invalid and out of the set.

kind.description: What the warning is: name-unlike-folder (its name is not its folder's name), frontmatter-name-invalid (its frontmatter name fails the skill-name rule, so it is named after its folder) or sidecar-invalid (its readiness sidecar does not read, and counts as none).

items.description: A warning on a member, which stays in the skill set.

warnings.description: Warnings that leave it in the set.

sourceId.description: A skill source's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adds the source, kept in lowercase.

oneOf.description: The environment's own skills directory, or its commands directory.

root.description: The repository root the member lies under: .claude/skills before .agents/skills, then .claude/commands.

directory.description: The directory holding that root, from the repository's root: the workspace directory or one of its parents, . for the repository's root; a nearer one wins a name.

layer.description: The layer a member lies in: a source, the own directory, or a trusted repository's .claude/skills or .agents/skills.

path.description: Where the member lies, from its layer's folder: in the own directory, skills/<folder> or commands/<file>; in a source's snapshot, its folder from the source's folder (. when that folder is itself the skill); in a trusted repository, its folder under the root.

anyOf.description: A member named by where it lies: its layer and its path from that layer's folder.

shadowedBy.description: The member holding its name that wins over it by precedence, which leaves this one out of the set; null for a member in the set, and for an invalid one.

native.description: Whether the session account's adapter loads this repository member itself under trust.

enabled.description: Whether its name is on for the view's account: the whole environment's choice, else the account's, else on. Off leaves it out of the set.

alwaysOn.description: Whether the view's account made its name always-on. A member switched off is never appended, whatever this says.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

anyOf.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accountId.description: The account the choice is for; null for the whole environment, whose choice outranks an account's.

enabled.description: Whether the name is on: off leaves it out of the set whichever layers hold it.

oneOf.description: A name switched off, or on again, for one account or the whole environment.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

accountId.description: The account whose runs append the member.

on.description: Whether every run of the account appends the member's body.

oneOf.description: A name made always-on, or not, for one account.

items.description: A choice made about a skill's name: enabled (on or off for an account, or for the whole environment with a null account, whose choice outranks an account's), or always-on for an account. Keyed by name; a choice for a name not in the set is inert.

choices.description: Every choice naming its name, for the whole environment or any account.

items.description: A member as skills.get lists it: the member, what shadows it, whether it is on and always-on for the view's account, and every choice naming it. In the set when it has no problem, nothing shadows it and it is on.

members.description: Every member of every layer, whether in the set, shadowed, switched off or invalid: by name, and within a name by precedence, highest first, so the first valid one is the one that wins; members without a name last, by precedence.

description: The environment's skills as skills.get answers them: the own directory's path, the sources, the choices, the accounts with their instruction channels, and the members of the set resolved for one account, each with its layer, any member that shadows it and its choices.
